verdict.rationale: Autumn supports some multi-item operations — multiAttach lets you attach multiple plans to a customer in one request, and the atmn CLI can push/pull an entire autumn.config.ts (many features/plans) in a single command — but there is no documented bulk API for operating across many customers or many balances/items at once. Missing for 10: batch endpoints for multiple customers, bulk update/track across many entities, and independent evidence of large-scale bulk usage.
